svg.title: Neurological problems from other systems: cancer (five mechanisms, including checkpoint inhibitor autoimmunity), breathlessness from bilateral phrenic nerve palsies, thiamine deficiency (Wernicke encephalopathy), other nutritional syndromes and refeeding, and multiple cardioembolic strokes from endocarditis; each column gives presentation, investigations and management
